description.p: Bitacora is a fast desktop outliner that reads and writes Logseq Markdown graphs without changing the files you did not touch. It indexes your graph for instant search, syncs it with git and can serve it to AI assistants over a local MCP endpoint.

ul.li: Fully compatible with Logseq file graphs (pages, journals, properties, assets)
Block outliner with undo and a local full-text index
Git sync with block-aware merging of concurrent edits
Optional MCP server bound to localhost, with audited and undoable writes
